text:
anya: Quick thought — our Console RBAC currently exposes ~12 roles + per-route scopes and folks find it confusing. Proposal: add an 'Access Matrix' view and standardize on 4 canonical roles (Admin, Developer, Viewer, Billing) with route-scoped toggles. Thoughts?

mike: +1 on simplifying. main worry is enterprise customers that depend on very fine-grained custom roles (model admin, key rotation, dataset access). how do we map existing custom roles to the canonical set?

sara: From product POV this seems good. canonical roles + per-route overrides should cover 90% of use cases. we need a migration preview so org admins can see how we'd map their current roles before any changes.

ethan: Backend note — auto-mapping is doable by analyzing ACLs over the last 30 days. we'll catch common patterns, but there will be edge cases where a custom role was used only once. we should surface low-confidence mappings.

joel: Security: must preserve audit trail and the original role UUIDs. also keep explicit deny semantics — the UI can't silently flip allow/deny for an org. any migration must be explicit and reversible.

anya: UX idea: Access Matrix table (roles x routes) with tri-state cells: Allow / Deny / Inherit. hover shows "last used by" + link to audit log. there should be a migration preview modal that highlights changes and low-confidence mappings.

mike: Implementation notes: current schema stores permissions as per-principal flat lists. we'll need a mapping layer and new endpoints: GET /orgs/{id}/access_matrix and POST /orgs/{id}/role_migration_preview. also consider pagination for very large orgs.

platform-bot: deploy:staging succeeded for branch 'access-matrix-ui' by mike — 30m ago

ethan: Rollout plan suggestion: 1) read-only preview + migration preview for org admins; 2) opt-in migration window; 3) new orgs created after X date get canonical roles by default. avoid forcing conversions on existing customers without opt-in.

sara: microcopy: call the feature "Access Matrix (preview)" and add clear copy: 'No permission changes until an admin confirms migration.' marketing might want a short doc for customers.

joel: add an enterprise flag to opt-out of migration (tenant-level). compliance customers should be able to keep legacy RBAC and ask support to migrate. document retention and audit IDs are critical.

anya: Action items: mike to spec backend endpoints + migration script; ethan to build usage telemetry + heatmap query; joel to draft compliance flag + audit requirements; sara to write UX microcopy and customer-facing preview copy. i'll sync with sales to surface customers who'd need custom handling.

mike: i'll create a design doc in /docs/eng/access-matrix-draft.md and link the migration plan. will ping #eng-platform when the doc is ready — ETA Tue.

sara: :thumbsup:
